content.guideline_title: 2017 High Blood Pressure Clinical Practice Guideline
content.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology (JACC)

sections.section: Management of hypertension in patients with heart failure
highlights: Effect of beta-blockers on mortality and heart failure outcomes in different patient populations (elderly, those with varying ejection fractions).
Use of ACE inhibitors and candesartan in chronic heart failure.
Significance of left ventricular ejection fraction in assessing heart failure.
Effects of dietary restriction and blood pressure control on progression of renal disease.
Importance of blood pressure management in non-diabetic chronic renal disease.

sections.section: Hypertension management through lifestyle and medication
highlights: Reduced sodium intake and its effects on blood pressure.
Pharmacological interventions for different patient demographics.
